The front portico is flat and does not project. The real eight-column portico stands forward of the cella with a full-width pediment, so I push the front colonnade out and widen the pediment. 3. The podium is too low and has no front steps. The real stylobate is a high, stepped platform, so I raise it and add a flight of steps. The roof, colour and overall footprint are already right.
